title: EODC Federation Extension
description: Federated-provider attribution and metadata-harmonization provenance for the EODC STAC catalogue. The federation is search-time only: collections are not merged, so each harmonized collection maps to exactly one source.

federation:backends.title: Federated providers
federation:backends.description: Providers that can serve this object.

provenance.title: Federation provenance
provenance.description: Where this collection came from and what the harmonization changed.

source.title: Source
source.description: The single source this collection corresponds to.

href.description: URL of the source collection, when it is a pass-through.

providers.description: Providers that serve the source collection.

harmonized.title: Harmonized
harmonized.description: The result of applying the EODC harmonization profile.

stac_version.description: STAC version of the harmonized collection.

upstream_stac_version.description: STAC version of the source, when it differed.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Plain-language summary of what the harmonization changed.
